title: Stage local work
statement: For an input specifying a positive dimension, positive rational bias at most one half, and an integral Fourier bound at least one, let $k<n$ and let $A$ be a family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates. The stage local-work quantity is the number of Goldreich–Levin candidates at stage $k$ determined by $A$, multiplied by the input’s restricted local-work quantity.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the bias numerator is at most its denominator
The integral Fourier bound is at least $1$
$A$ is a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The candidate construction and the restricted-weight data used to define local work are not supplied.
